ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black and dark-grey pixels comprising the remaining 25% in a mottled distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense low-intensity pigmentation clusters at the far-right distal tip; a high frequency of circular dark blobs scattered throughout the mid-sections of both lobes; a linear series of small dark spots following the upper-left trailing margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; depth penetrates roughly 20% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-to-moderate frequency serration; the right distal edge exhibits higher-amplitude jagged peaks compared to the relatively smoother left trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves that peak at the mid-lobe before descending in a roughly linear trajectory towards the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular and 'donut-shaped' dark pixel clusters visible across the right lobe; left lobe displays smaller, more isolated circular clusters concentrated near the upper-left margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark horizontal linear pixel disruption is visible on the right proximal lobe, originating near the median notch and extending laterally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible horizontal scar on the right lobe near the notch; irregular jaggedness on the extreme right distal tip suggests localized tissue loss or scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique map-like interconnected mottling pattern covering the distal 30% of the right fluke lobe.
